entries.title: Mark 15:1
segments: As soon as it was daylight, the Chief Priests, after holding a consultation with the Councillors and Teachers of the Law--that is to say, the whole High Council--put Jesus in chains, and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate.

entries.title: Mark 15:2
segments: "Are you the King of the Jews?" asked Pilate. "It is true," replied Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 15:3
segments: Then the Chief Priests brought a number of charges against him;

entries.title: Mark 15:4
segments: Upon which Pilate questioned Jesus again. "Have you no reply to make?" he asked. "Listen, how many charges they are bringing against you."

entries.title: Mark 15:5
segments: But Jesus still made no reply whatever; at which Pilate was astonished.

entries.title: Mark 15:6
segments: Now, at the Feast, Pilate used to grant the people the release of any one prisoner whom they might ask for.

entries.title: Mark 15:7
segments: A man called Barabbas was in prison, with the rioters who had committed murder during a riot.

entries.title: Mark 15:8
segments: So, when the crowd went up and began to ask Pilate to follow his usual custom,

entries.title: Mark 15:9
segments: He answered: "Do you want me to release the 'King of the Jews' for you?"

entries.title: Mark 15:10
segments: For he was aware that it was out of jealousy that the Chief Priests had given Jesus up to him.

entries.title: Mark 15:11
segments: But the Chief Priests incited the crowd to get Barabbas released instead.

entries.title: Mark 15:12
segments: Pilate, however, spoke to them again: "What shall I do then with the man whom you call the 'King of the Jews'?"

entries.title: Mark 15:13
segments: Again they shouted: "Crucify him!"

entries.title: Mark 15:14
segments: "Why, what harm has he done?" Pilate kept saying to them. But they shouted furiously: "Crucify him!"

entries.title: Mark 15:15
segments: And Pilate, wishing to satisfy the crowd, released Barabbas to them, and, after scourging Jesus, gave him up to be crucified.

entries.title: Mark 15:16
segments: The soldiers then took Jesus away into the court-yard--that is the Government House--and they called the whole garrison together.

entries.title: Mark 15:17
segments: They dressed him in a purple robe, and, having twisted a crown of thorns, put it on him,

entries.title: Mark 15:18
segments: And then began to salute him. "Long life to you, King of the Jews!" they said.

entries.title: Mark 15:19
segments: And they kept striking him on the head with a rod, spitting at him, and bowing to the ground before him--going down on their knees;

entries.title: Mark 15:20
segments: And, when they had left off mocking him, they took off the purple robe, and put his own clothes on him.

entries.title: Mark 15:21
segments: And they led Jesus out to crucify him; and they compelled a passer-by, Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them to carry his cross.

entries.title: Mark 15:22
segments: They brought Jesus to the place which was known as Golgotha- -a name which means 'Place of a Skull.'

entries.title: Mark 15:23
segments: There they offered him drugged wine; but Jesus refused it.

entries.title: Mark 15:24
segments: Then they crucified him, and divided his clothes among them, casting lots for them, to settle what each should take.

entries.title: Mark 15:25
segments: It was nine in the morning when they crucified him.

entries.title: Mark 15:26
segments: The words of the charge against him, written up over his head, ran thus--'THE KING OF THE JEWS.'

entries.title: Mark 15:27
segments: And with him they crucified two robbers, one on the right, and the other on the left.

entries.title: Mark 15:28
segments: (Translation omits this verse)

entries.title: Mark 15:29
segments: The passers-by railed at him, shaking their heads, as they said: "Ah! you who 'destroy the Temple and build one in three days,

entries.title: Mark 15:30
segments: 'come down from the cross and save yourself!"

entries.title: Mark 15:31
segments: In the same way the Chief Priests, with the Teachers of the Law, said to one another in mockery:

entries.title: Mark 15:32
segments: "He saved others, but he cannot save himself! Let the Christ, the 'King of Israel,' come down from the cross now, that we may see it and believe." Even the men who had been crucified with Jesus reviled him.

entries.title: Mark 15:33
segments: At midday, a darkness came over the whole country, lasting till three in the afternoon.

entries.title: Mark 15:34
segments: And, at three, Jesus called out loudly: "`Eloi, Eloi, lama sabacthani?'" which means 'My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?'

entries.title: Mark 15:35
segments: Some of those standing round heard this, and said: "Listen! He is calling for Elijah!"

entries.title: Mark 15:36
segments: And a man ran, and, soaking a sponge in common wine, put it on the end of a rod, and offered it to him to drink, saying as he did so: "Wait and let us see if Elijah is coming to take him down."

entries.title: Mark 15:37
segments: But Jesus, giving a loud cry, expired.

entries.title: Mark 15:38
segments: The Temple curtain was torn in two from top to bottom.

entries.title: Mark 15:39
segments: The Roman Officer, who was standing facing Jesus, on seeing the way in which he expired, exclaimed: "This man must indeed have been 'God's Son'!"

entries.title: Mark 15:40
segments: There were some women also watching from a distance, among them being Mary of Magdala, Mary the mother of James the Little and of Joseph, and Salome--

entries.title: Mark 15:41
segments: All of whom used to accompany Jesus when he was in Galilee, and attend on him--besides many other women who had come up with him to Jerusalem.

entries.title: Mark 15:42
segments: The evening had already fallen, when, as it was the Preparation Day--the day before the Sabbath--

entries.title: Mark 15:43
segments: Joseph from Ramah, a Councillor of good position, who was himself living in expectation of the Kingdom of God, came and ventured to go in to see Pilate, and to ask for the body of Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 15:44
segments: But Pilate was surprised to hear that he had already died. So he sent for the Officer, and asked if he were already dead;

entries.title: Mark 15:45
segments: And, on learning from the Officer that it was so, he gave the corpse to Joseph.

entries.title: Mark 15:46
segments: Joseph, having bought a linen sheet, took Jesus down, and wound the sheet round him, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of the rock; and then rolled a stone up against the entrance of the tomb.

entries.title: Mark 15:47
segments: Mary of Magdala and Mary, the mother of Joseph, were watching to see where he was laid.
